# Electron (desktop app)

These rules add to the core build skills of the quality pack.

## Rules

- Every window: contextIsolation on, nodeIntegration off, sandbox kept, webSecurity on. The page never gets Node.js.
- System access goes through a preload script exposing, with contextBridge, a short list of named functions; never the whole ipcRenderer.
- Every ipcMain handler validates the sender and its arguments like a server route.
- Windows load local files or https; navigation and new windows are filtered (will-navigate, setWindowOpenHandler); shell.openExternal only opens checked https addresses.
- Content security policy set; no remote module.
- Stay on one of the three latest Electron major versions: older ones no longer receive Chromium security fixes.
- Heavy work in a utility process or a worker, never in the main process, which would freeze every window.
- Signed updates (electron-updater or update-electron-app), installers signed and notarised in CI.
- Secrets with safeStorage or the system keychain; data in app.getPath('userData').
- To check the interface in the real window: start the app with --remote-debugging-port=9222, then qp flows --attach 9222.

## Check commands

Used by `/qp:audit`. `{pm}` is the project's package manager, `{url}` the app URL, `{host}` its host name.

| Check | Command | Passes if |
| --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | `{pm} exec tsc --noEmit` | exit code 0 |
| lint | `{pm} run lint` | exit code 0, no errors |
| test_run | `{pm} test` | exit code 0 |
| deps_audit | `{pm} audit --audit-level=high` | no high or critical advisory; Electron itself on a supported major version |
| license_check | `npx --yes license-checker-rseidelsohn --summary --failOn 'GPL;AGPL'` | exit code 0 |
